text: Refunds are available within 30 days of purchase. Contact billing with the invoice number.
Reset your password using the Forgot password link on the login screen. The reset email expires in 15 minutes.
Export workspace data from Settings then Data export. Only workspace administrators can export CSV files.
Enterprise customers receive a first support response within 2 hours during business days.
Cancel a subscription in Settings then Billing. Access remains available until the paid period ends.
Deleted account data is removed after 90 days. Backups expire after 120 days.

Beacon support responds within 48 hours. Enterprise escalation is not offered.
